intro.title: Acme **Reports**
intro.sub: A tiny app used to check the video pipeline.

items.v: Nobody can answer: are we growing?

beats.say: This is Acme Reports, a tiny app that lets us test the whole video pipeline.
Most teams keep their numbers in several tools, and none of them answers one simple question. Are we growing?
On the overview tab, four numbers show how the week went.
Below it, the revenue trend. Notice that the email and the key on the next card are blurred.
The usage tab shows who is actually using the product.
This table is wider than the screen, so we scroll it sideways to see every column.
That is everything the pipeline does in one short run.
